clips.title: The story
paras: The Dead Acre is a ruined, smoldering farmstead in southeastern Westfall near the river bridge to Duskwood. Burned to ash by the Defias Brotherhood during their uprising across the countryside, the blackened fields are now abandoned by people and stalked by rogue harvest golems.

Situated just north of the road linking Sentinel Hill to Duskwood, the Dead Acre was once a productive homestead among the breadbasket farms of Westfall. When the Defias Brotherhood rose in revolt and drove out the local landowners, this farm met a violent end. The homestead and its surrounding crops were put to the torch, leaving behind scorched timber, smoking earth, and wandering mechanical Harvest Watchers that still reap the barren soil.
